scope: Existing original print callers, source literals and current numeric/location values

checks.name: Met locations use the existing print sequence with original complete location terms and the original Met suffix
Unknown locations, shortened location names and appended independent clauses stay raw without prior-location reuse
Ribbon counts overwrite only the two original trailing zeroes with each current observed count and digit width
Zero, padded, signed, separated and out-of-range ribbon counts cannot acquire a guessed original format
Remaining experience follows the original numeric-only caller while preserving currently observed digit widths
Met levels use only the original marker, current visible level and source comma without adding Chinese connector text
All frozen native-field occurrences retain raw numeric evidence and reproduce their separately frozen original-format expectations
Changed original words, punctuation, source digests or unapproved printing operations reject the native pack
